Visitor skips mark elements entirely

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_mark(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<p>Key insight: <mark>always validate input</mark> for security.</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
